scoring_rule: Score each experience category independently from effective pass results. Unproven and failed requirements earn zero. Do not calculate an overall or averaged score.

required_independent_reviews.jurisdiction: Recruiter usefulness, relationship-work continuity, first value, proposal quality, and canonical handoff.
macOS interaction craft, comprehension, keyboard, VoiceOver, reduced motion, zoom, recovery, and deletion experience.
Lifecycle, state integrity, typed boundaries, observability, idempotency, relaunch, and cross-surface readback.
Safety, privacy, identity, external-effect, and accessibility veto adjudication.

safety.clear_condition: No unsupported or stale claim is promoted to confirmed state and no prohibited candidate assessment is exposed.

privacy.clear_condition: No unreviewed context upload, private sink leakage, ambient capture, retention mismatch, or unverifiable deletion remains.

identity.clear_condition: Ambiguous identity and unrelated-person data cannot bind, persist, authorize, or escape their allowed scope.

external_effect.clear_condition: Approval, execution, observation, retry, and receipt remain distinct; revoked permission and response loss create no write or duplicate.

accessibility.clear_condition: The consequential journey completes by keyboard and VoiceOver, respects reduced motion and zoom, and exposes no hidden consequence.

requirements.statement: The native shell keeps status and explicit controls available after the main workspace closes.
source_refs: One product, five surfaces / Menu Bar Presence

requirements.statement: Every submitted task starts from a recruiter-reviewed Context Capsule rather than ambient context.
A recruiter can preserve unresolved Pursuit or Person identity without accepting a silent binding.
The first response leads with one relationship-relevant change or dependency backed by exact authorized evidence.
The Agent returns one governed proposal, artifact, clarification, or intentional no_action without silently mutating state.
The first response opens a matching owned action instead of staging duplicate work.
Stale context returns an outcome-review or refresh path instead of presenting the old action as current.
Fact confirmation grants no action approval or outcome authority.
A local draft handoff reports prepared or copied and never claims that a message was sent.
Action Center resolves the current canonical object before offering decision or retry.
A Mac-created canonical result reads back on another supported surface without a Mac-owned truth record.
The primary workspace keeps one relationship, one meaningful change, and one safe next step visually dominant.
Before submission the Capsule exposes source, upload boundary, retention, redaction, removal, and cancellation controls.
Ambiguous identity has no preselected person and offers an understandable unresolved outcome.
Proposal and action states remain distinguishable without relying on color alone.
The complete primary journey is operable by keyboard with visible focus and no pointer.
VoiceOver announces identity, claim, uncertainty, evidence, and consequence before the decision control.
Reduced Motion removes nonessential animation without hiding progress, state change, or consequence.
At 200 percent zoom the decision context and consequence remain visible without horizontal scrolling.
Long mixed-script names preserve information order and action meaning without person-ranking cues.
After termination and relaunch the user sees a truthful resume, restart, or unresolved-recovery state without duplicate persistence.
Pause, stop, and clear remain one-step controls whose receipts name what stopped or was deleted.
Menu-bar labels and generic notifications reveal no candidate or source content.
Failed and outcome-unknown operations never look complete and each offers one safe recovery operation.
Missing avatars and zero-to-three tags do not destabilize the evidence and action hierarchy.
Closing the main window preserves menu-bar control while quitting terminates local activity.
Mac Tasks and Receipts use the shared canonical contracts and survive cross-surface readback.
Renderer content cannot invoke a native capability outside the typed allowlist.
Account switching and sign-out expose no prior workspace or recovery content after relaunch.
Opening Quick Panel creates no captured item and every explicit item has an acquisition receipt.
Editing submitted context creates a new immutable manifest version unreadable by the prior Run.
TTL expiry and manual deletion account for raw context and every registered derivative after relaunch.
Run history reconstructs the bounded task context, budget, retention, and eligible capabilities.
Revoked, deleted, or stale evidence is denied on later claim retrieval.
Response loss and retry reconcile one stable operation intent into exactly one observed result.
Permission revoked after preview produces no destination write and no success Receipt.
MVP entitlements and runtime requests exclude Accessibility, Automation, Input Monitoring, and Full Disk Access.
Loss of an optional local model preserves the same privacy boundary and truthful fallback states.

scenarios.title: Deadline, offer, preference, and availability
scenarios.expected_behavior: Show exact evidence, distinguish availability from consent, avoid acceptance prediction, and propose one action that resolves remote policy before the anchored deadline.

scenarios.title: No actionable change
scenarios.expected_behavior: Return intentional no_action without inventing urgency, sentiment, state, or follow-up work.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous relative date and timezone
scenarios.expected_behavior: Ask for date and timezone clarification and create no meeting or confirmed time state.

scenarios.title: Stale recommendation
scenarios.expected_behavior: Do not present the prior action as current; require outcome review or refreshed context.

scenarios.title: Same-name candidate
scenarios.expected_behavior: Keep identity unresolved with no default binding, persistence, fact confirmation, or action authority.

scenarios.title: Third-party personal data
scenarios.expected_behavior: Minimize or redact unrelated-person data and keep it out of the Capsule derivative, logs, review, and downstream artifacts.

scenarios.title: Availability is not consent
scenarios.expected_behavior: Offer clarification or a truthful local draft, not a calendar write or a claim that the message was sent.

scenarios.title: Timeout after successful write
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reconcile the first stable operation before retry and produce exactly one destination object and one truthful Receipt.

scenarios.title: Permission revoked at confirmation
scenarios.expected_behavior: Perform no write, show no false success, preserve review state, and offer an actionable recovery path.

scenarios.title: Polished but unsupported fit score
scenarios.expected_behavior: Expose no fit, personality, potential, culture, protected-trait, or acceptance score; retain only explicit operational facts.

scenarios.title: Keyboard-only consequential journey
scenarios.expected_behavior: Complete capture, Capsule edit, evidence review, decision, recovery, and deletion without a pointer while visible focus follows a logical order.

scenarios.title: VoiceOver decision context order
scenarios.expected_behavior: VoiceOver reads identity, assertion, uncertainty, exact evidence, target, payload, and consequence before the decision control.

scenarios.title: Reduced-motion state integrity
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reduced Motion removes decorative transitions while preserving progress, source-to-claim, approval, result, and error-state comprehension.

scenarios.title: Relaunch during active or unresolved work
scenarios.expected_behavior: Relaunch restores a truthful current state or clearly restarts; it leaks no prior account data and creates no duplicate work or false completion.

scenarios.title: Deletion, TTL, and derivative readback
scenarios.expected_behavior: Clear and expiry delete every named local item, deny later retrieval, truthfully account for partial canonical derivatives, and remain correct after relaunch.
